title: Drought forecast skill versus warning skill: code, data and results (REV6)
description:
Companion archive for the article Persistence wins on days, calibrated machine-learning forecasts anticipate more drought onsets: verifying data-driven drought warnings in eastern Indonesia (submitted to Natural Hazards). It contains the forecasting and verification pipeline (REV6: out-of-sample post-processing, onset and episode verification, block-bootstrap uncertainty), daily NASA POWER input data for ten grid cells across the Nusa Tenggara dry-season gradient (Indonesia), the daily forecasts and verification results of the in-domain and leave-one-cell-out transfer experiments, and the scripts in paper_analysis_rev6/ that regenerate every table and figure of the article. Earlier versions (up to 1.1.0) accompanied an earlier manuscript and their material is retained in results/, results_mc/ and paper_analysis/.

Code is released under the MIT licence; data and results under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).
